First launch

Cloudless is recipe-first

Cloudless is designed to start with a ready-to-use recipe: a tested configuration that brings together the model, engine, launch settings, and hardware optimizations. Open Model Manager to browse recipes, or use the Guide if you want to explore every option yourself.

Nothing is downloaded or started from this screen.
Recipes, explained simplyA model is the AI brain. A recipe is the complete setup kit: it chooses a compatible model and engine, applies the right settings for your hardware, and includes the checks Cloudless needs to run it reliably. You can inspect a recipe before installing or running it.
Recommended for this DGX SparkStart with the Laguna S 2.1 recipe in Model Manager. It provides a ready-to-use configuration optimized for DGX Spark.
